wa.table.kept.context: add to a table Taskiem keeps (the money log)

wa.table.list_line.context: tables: one table with its estimated row count

wa.table.list_line_nocount.context: tables: one table whose count could not be had

wa.table.list_tail_add.text: Send *add to* and a table's name to add a row.

wa.table.list_tail_find.text: Send *find*, a table's name and a word to look up rows.

wa.table.needs_values.text:
Adding a row to {table} ({count} column(s)). Send *cancel* to stop.

{prompt}
wa.table.needs_values.context: add: columns asked one by one; {prompt} is the first column's question

wa.table.no_match.text: No data table matches {name}. Send *tables* to see them.
wa.table.no_match.context: add or find: no table matches; {name} is quoted

wa.table.none.text: {org} has no data tables yet. Create one in Taskiem, under Tables{link}.
wa.table.none.context: tables: none; {link} is wa.link_at or empty

wa.table.not_added.text: The row was not added to {table}: {reason}. Send *add to* again.
wa.table.not_added.context: The row failed the table's checks at the end (the columns changed)

wa.table.optional.context: Under a column's question when it may be left empty

wa.table.pick_again.text:
Send a number from the list, or *cancel*:
{list}
wa.table.pick_again.context: add: the pick was not a number on the list

wa.table.too_many.text: You have added several rows just now. Wait a minute, then try again.
wa.table.too_many.context: Rate limit on rows added from chat

wa.table.unavailable.text: Data tables cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
wa.table.unavailable.context: Xenibase or the connection could not be used

wa.table.which.context: add: several tables match; {list} is numbered

wa.too_fast.text: You are sending messages too quickly. Wait a minute, then try again.
wa.too_fast.context: Rate limit on a number's messages

wa.unbound.text: This number is not linked to a Taskiem account. To use Taskiem here, sign in, open {where}, add this number under WhatsApp, then type or send back the code we send you.
wa.unbound.context: A number linked to no one wrote

wd.alongside.context: Read-back of a built workflow: a branch that runs alongside others; {name} is the tenant's

wd.and.context: Read-back: the last of a list of days; {list} is comma-separated

wd.approval.policy.context: Read-back: approval under a named policy; {policy} is the tenant's

wd.approval.role_many.text: Ask {count} people with the {role} role to approve
wd.approval.role_many.context: Read-back: approval by several people with a role

wd.approval.role_one.context: Read-back: approval by one person with a role; {role} is the tenant's

wd.approval.timeout.context: Read-back: how long an approval waits; {approval} is the approval line

wd.capability.text: {what} with whichever payments account is connected
wd.capability.context: Read-back: a capability step with no connection named; {what} is the capability, e.g. Pay a bank account

wd.capability.via.context: Read-back: a capability step; {what} is the capability, {connection} the connection's name

wd.code_language.context: Read-back: the tenant's own code; {language} is a programming language

wd.connector.context: Read-back: a connector step; {action} and {connector} are the connector's own names

wd.container_named.context: Read-back: a container step; {image} is the image's name

wd.foreach.text: For each item in the list:
wd.foreach.context: Read-back: steps repeated for each item

wd.foreach_limited.text: For each item in the list (at most {count} at a time):
wd.foreach_limited.context: Read-back: steps repeated for each item, {count} at a time at most

wd.form.context: Read-back: a form step that sends someone a form and waits for the answers; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.email.text: Ask someone, by their email address, to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.email.context: Read-back: a form step whose link goes to an email address from the run; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.phone.text: Ask someone, by their phone number, to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.phone.context: Read-back: a form step whose link goes to a phone number from the run; {title} is the tenant's

wd.form.role.text: Ask members with the {role} role to fill in “{title}”
wd.form.role.context: Read-back: a form step for members with a role; {role} and {title} are the tenant's

wd.form.timeout.context: Read-back: how long a form step waits for the answers; {form} is the form step's line

wd.http.context: Read-back: a call to a web service

wd.http_host.context: Read-back: a call to a web service; {host} and {method} are technical, keep them

wd.http_service.context: Read-back: a call to a web service whose address is worked out when it runs

wd.if.context: Read-back: one path of a decision; {name} is the tenant's

wd.on_error.context: Read-back: steps run when the step above fails

wd.only_when.context: Read-back: a step that runs only when its condition holds; {step} says what it does

wd.or.context: Read-back: joins event names (keep the spaces)

wd.otherwise.context: Read-back: the path taken when no other applies

wd.parallel.text: Do these at the same time:
wd.parallel.context: Read-back: branches run at the same time

wd.schedule.daily.context: Read-back: a schedule; {time} is HH:MM and {tz} a time zone such as Africa/Lagos

wd.schedule.days.context: Read-back: a schedule; {days} are day names (wd.day.*)

wd.schedule.hourly_at.context: Read-back: a schedule; {minute} is minutes past the hour

wd.schedule.last_day.text: On the last day of every month at {time} ({tz} time)

wd.schedule.monthly.text: On the {day} of every month at {time} ({tz} time)
wd.schedule.monthly.context: Read-back: a schedule; {day} is the day of the month: '25th' in English, the number alone in other languages

wd.schedule.raw.context: Read-back: a schedule shown as written; {cron} is the expression

wd.schedule.raw_local.context: Read-back: a schedule shown as written; {cron} is the expression

wd.schedule.weekdays.text: Every weekday (Monday to Friday) at {time} ({tz} time)

wd.signal_named.context: Read-back: waits for a named event; {event} is the tenant's

wd.transform.text: Prepare the data for the next steps
wd.transform.context: Read-back: a step that reshapes data

wd.trigger.capability_event.context: Read-back: started by a payment event from whichever payments account is connected; {events} are the events, e.g. A payout failed; the money is back

wd.trigger.database_change.context: Read-back: started by a database change

wd.trigger.event.context: Read-back: started by a connector's event; {trigger} is its name

wd.trigger.event_reports.context: Read-back: started by a connector's events; {connector} and {events} are names

wd.trigger.form.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}”
wd.trigger.form.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form anyone with its link can fill in; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.form_link.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}” (only with a link sent to them)
wd.trigger.form_link.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form opened by one-time links; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.form_members.text: When someone fills in the form “{title}” (members only)
wd.trigger.form_members.context: Read-back: started by a hosted form only signed-in members can fill in; {title} is the tenant's

wd.trigger.other.context: Read-back: started some other way; {type} is the trigger's type

wd.trigger.polling.context: Read-back: checks a connector for new items every {interval}

wd.trigger.storefront.text: When someone sends the storefront's {form} form
wd.trigger.storefront.context: Read-back: started by a form on the business's public storefront; {form} is order, enquiry or callback

wd.trigger.ussd.text: When someone dials the USSD code
wd.trigger.ussd.context: Read-back: started by a USSD session

wd.trigger.webhook.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address

wd.trigger.webhook_checked.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address (checked with {auth})
wd.trigger.webhook_checked.context: Read-back: what starts the workflow; {auth} is how calls are checked (hmac, bearer...)

wd.trigger.webhook_unsigned.text: When your system calls this workflow's web address (no signature check)
wd.trigger.webhook_unsigned.context: Read-back: what starts the workflow (calls are not signed)

wd.trigger.whatsapp.text: When a message arrives on WhatsApp
wd.trigger.whatsapp.context: Read-back: started by a WhatsApp message

wd.wait_for.context: Read-back: a pause; {duration} is read aloud (wd.unit.*)

wd.wait_until.context: Read-back: a pause until a set time
